title: Bar Drop Summer Dream 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Summer Dream by Drop is the ultimate tropical fruit salad. This complex medley combines the juicy sweetness of mango, orange, pineapple and watermelon with the exotic tang of passion fruit. It is a vibrant, multi-layered blend that captures the essence of summer in every puff. The unique 40% VG / 60% PG ratio is perfect for such a complex mix, ensuring that every individual fruit note—from the zesty orange to the lush mango—can be tasted clearly. Designed for use in MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) pod kits, the nicotine salt formula offers quick satisfaction and a smooth draw in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts are brought to you by Drop and are manufactured right here in the UK. Drop’s collections focus on fabulously fruity flavours that are achingly authentic and blend familiar favourites with unique profiles.
